releaseNotes: A typed definition graph now owns stable IDs and relationships for business areas, domains, 57 workflows, context packs, phases, readiness lanes, artifacts, gates, operators, and providers. SKILL.md domain routing, the phase spine, graph documentation, Mermaid topology, and context budgets are deterministic projections checked by check:skill-graph.

Phase order, required lanes, and lane dependencies now derive from the graph runtime instead of a second hard-coded topology in launch-state.ts. The Control Plane read model moves to schema 0.2.0 with stable operator and view IDs, and app-local role prompts declare their canonical operator identities.

PROJECT_STATE.yaml remains the compatible business-instance contract and now records definition_graph_version 1.0.0. The public business/ paths stay unchanged; immutable skill definitions remain outside mutable launch state.
